name: loseii-site
description: www.loseii.com (Cloudflare Pages). The site itself needs no build; `npm run build` makes an optional minified copy in dist/. `npm run check` runs the same offline checks as CI (.github/workflows/checks.yml).

scripts.check: npm run check:tools && npm run check:html && npm run check:shared-pins && npm run check:cross-pins && npm run check:bracelet && npm run check:astrogem-pins && npm run check:gpd && npm run check:loseii && npm run check:py
scripts.check:py: npm run check:py:market && npm run check:py:astrogem && npm run check:py:crafting && npm run check:py:hellkey
